required_outcomes: Recognises the reading is not done despite 'done complete' at event 014: the landlord cannot read the kWh figure and needs it by 31 January.

Asks the tenant now for a clearer photo, saying what must be legible (the total generation kWh figure, display lit, close up and in focus) and by when, with a date that leaves time to forward it before 31 January.
Replies to the landlord that a clearer photo has been requested and when she can expect it.
Records a dated review before 31 January through a verified action (hold or follow-up), so a slow reply is chased in time.
acceptable_alternatives: Phoning the tenant instead of emailing, since he responded after a call last time, provided the call is logged and a dated review is set.
Opening a new request for the replacement photo instead of reopening this one.
positive_behaviours: Asks the landlord when the next reading after this one is due, as she has not said.
Suggests the tenant also type out the figure in his reply, so a second blurred photo does not cause another round.
red_flags: Treating the case as complete, or forwarding the same photo to the landlord again.
Escalating to a human over a blurred photo.
prohibited_actions: Telling the landlord a meter figure that nobody has confirmed as legible.
Assigning a maintenance provider or raising any cost.
critical_failures: The case is left completed with no new photo requested from the tenant, so the landlord's 31 January submission is missed.
